title: Get your small business permits with a 30-day review

paragraphs: Open a new business or change your business operations.
Some businesses are eligible for a streamlined, 30-day review of their business permits.

Voters approved Prop H in 2020, creating this streamlined review and approval process for small business permits. The Small Business Recovery Act was passed by the Board of Supervisors that same year and expanded the impact of Prop H. Together, they eliminate months of permitting requirements and processes for businesses opening in San Francisco.

sections.heading: Check what kinds of projects are eligible
paragraphs: These projects are not eligible for 30-day review:
Projects that expand the footprint of the building
Projects that expand the interior square footage of the business

sections.heading: Check what forms you need for your business permits
paragraphs: Answer our questions and we will tell you what forms you need to fill out to get your business permits.
We will ask you for your contact info, business address, and project details.
If you are not doing construction, you will need your Business Account Number (BAN) to have your permits issued.

sections.heading: Fill out the forms from your confirmation email
paragraphs: We will email you all the forms you need to fill out.
If you are not eligible for a 30-day review, we will email you within 3 business days.
Even if you are not eligible for the 30-day review, these are still the forms you will need to fill out to get your business permit.

sections.heading: Submit your forms for your business permits
paragraphs: After you fill out your forms, submit them to us.
We will email you a link to submit your forms.

sections.heading: Wait for our follow-up email
paragraphs: We will email you within 5 business days to confirm that your application is complete and accurate.
Once the application is complete and accurate, the 30-day review period starts.
